summary: HLT long rejected on Gate 4. Expected return was positive (+$2.15/share: combined_p_bull=0.477 from bull_a strength=6 / bear_a strength=6 and bull_b=5 / bear_b=6; entry 340.25, target 350.50, stop 335.00), and budget had capacity, but at ~$340/share the Gate-3 quantity of 47 (risk_per_share=5.25, $250 risk budget) produces $15,992 notional, far above the 15% standard cap ($3,750). The small-scaled exception also fails: max-viable M=14 shares (notional $4,764 within the 20% extended cap of $5,000) deploys only $73.50 of risk = 29% of the budget, below the required 40% floor ($100). Stock is too high-priced for the $25k account to fit even a minimum scaled position with meaningful risk.
